principle: Phases advance on metrics, not dates. Every duration is a target; each phase ends in an explicit go / adjust / kill decision against pre-defined gates. A phase whose months have elapsed but whose gate has not cleared iterates or stops — it does not advance.
north_star: 3rd-update-in-30-days retention, segmented by follower count — the share who start a Journey and post a third update within 30 days, broken out by how many followers they have. The segmentation is the point: a healthy aggregate that hides weak small-account retention is a false positive.
kill_metric: If 3rd-update retention is weak across ALL follower segments after a fair test, the core loop is broken and no distribution will save it → kill or fundamentally redesign. Weak retention in only small segments is a fixable discovery problem, not a kill.

marketing_track.summary: Marketing is a continuous cross-cutting track, not a phase — it begins before launch and runs through every phase, because a new format's norms are set by its earliest content and advocates.
points: Hero campaign: ‘Everyone Starts at Day One’ (CTA: ‘Start your Day One’) — reframes sharing an awkward beginning as brave, not exposing.
Phase 0: seed the norm via the Founding Journeys creator program (incentive = amplification).
Phase 1: launch the campaign wave by wave through beachhead communities; owned surfaces only — no Reels entry point.
Phase 2+: completed-Journey recaps become the self-renewing marketing asset.
Ongoing: match category-appropriate creators to each new surface (life-event creators lead Facebook; skill creators lead the Reels CTA).

phases.name: Seeded Closed Beta
phases.goal: Prove the core loop in a contained population and deliberately set what a “good Journey” looks like before any scale.
ship: Core Journey creation (AI-inferred theme tag)
Story-style posts, off the main grid
Journey page + story-style viewer
Meta AI behind a ‘need inspiration?’ prompt (organic)
Pause / archive / complete recap
Optional reminders (default off)
Niche discovery ON, broad amplification OFF
Launch Founding Journeys creator program (incentive = amplification)
measure: Activation: % of invited who start a Journey
★ 3rd-update/30d retention, by follower segment
AI helpfulness rating (‘was this helpful?’)
Completion + pause/archive usage

decision.label: Go
decision.text: Loop retains across segments and AI is helpful → proceed to public launch.

decision.label: Adjust
decision.text: Weak only for small accounts (the void problem) → strengthen discovery before scaling; scaling a void wastes traffic.

decision.label: Kill / redesign
decision.text: Weak across ALL segments → the format itself isn’t compelling.

phases.name: Public Launch on Instagram
phases.goal: Prove the loop generalizes beyond hand-picked communities and validate cold-start mechanics at real scale — does the median user, not the enthusiast, sustain a Journey?
ship: Open Journeys to all Instagram users
‘Follow along’ — subscribe without following
First-update invite → updates appear in feeds
Resurface high-performing Journeys
Explore ‘Journeys’ tab (niche, interest-matched)
Optional ‘turn this Highlight into a Journey?’ prompt
Launch ‘Everyone Starts at Day One’ campaign, wave by wave
Owned surfaces only — NO Reels entry point yet
measure: Creation rate + ★ 3rd-update retention by segment (primary gate)
Follow-along acceptance rate
Explore → follow-along rate (is niche discovery beating the void?)
Highlight → Journey conversion
Day-30 / day-90 retention; sustained AI helpfulness

decision.label: Go
decision.text: Small-account retention holds because niche discovery works, and follow-along converts → proceed to monetization.

decision.label: Adjust
decision.text: Follow-along converts poorly → simplify or rework the subscribe model before building on it.

decision.label: Hold
decision.text: Small-account retention still poor despite discovery → hold monetization & scale; the ‘get recognized’ promise is hollow until discovery is fixed.

phases.name: Monetization + WhatsApp
phases.goal: Turn on revenue only after the AI has proven useful, and add the highest-leverage cross-app retention mechanic. Trust is the prerequisite for monetization, not a nice-to-have.
ship: Sponsored, clearly-labeled recs in Meta AI (gated on trust data)
WhatsApp: opt-in ‘share to your group?’ + update pings
Emphasize life-documentation types (parenting, travel)
Cautious broad amplification of proven Journeys
measure: Sponsored CTR vs standard ads; incremental ARPU
Guardrail: do sponsored recs dent helpfulness / retention?
WhatsApp opt-in + its effect on update frequency & retention

decision.label: Go
decision.text: Sponsored recs convert without denting trust and WhatsApp lifts retention → both bets paid.

decision.label: Adjust
decision.text: Sponsored recs tank helpfulness → pull back, re-tune labeling/frequency; protect trust.

decision.label: Deprioritize
decision.text: WhatsApp doesn’t move retention → it was a high-conviction bet, not a certainty; don’t sink more build into it.

phases.name: Soft Acquisition: Video Journeys in Reels
phases.goal: Give Journeys a low-risk on-ramp into the firehose without touching the Reels format or algorithm — a gentle test of whether Reels traffic converts before any aggressive change.
ship: Video Journeys viewable in Reels with a ‘view full journey?’ button (format & algorithm untouched)
Broad algorithmic amplification of proven Journeys begins
measure: ‘View full journey?’ tap-through + follow-along conversion
Do viewers who arrive via Reels retain like organic users?
Guardrail: no degradation of core Reels metrics (watch time, session retention)

decision.label: Go
decision.text: Reels tap-through converts and Reels metrics hold → proceed to the active AI CTA.

decision.label: Hold
decision.text: Reels-sourced followers don’t retain → fix targeting before building the higher-risk CTA.

phases.name: Active Acquisition: AI ‘Try This Out?’ CTA in Reels
phases.goal: Turn Reels into a proactive acquisition engine — the single highest-risk change in the plan, which is exactly why it ships only after the passive version and everything before it has cleared.
ship: ‘Try this out?’ AI CTA on skill-based Reels → Meta AI recommends a start (creators, communities, products) and can spin up a new Journey directly
measure: Reels → Journey conversion (tap & start/follow)
Guardrail (non-negotiable): Reels watch time / session retention must hold
Do CTA-sourced Journeys retain, or does a proactive prompt import low-intent users?

decision.label: Go
decision.text: CTA converts and Reels metrics hold → Reels becomes the primary acquisition engine.

decision.label: Re-target
decision.text: CTA-sourced Journeys don’t retain → the prompt is too broad; tighten who sees it.

decision.label: Pull it
decision.text: CTA hurts Reels engagement at all → revert immediately; Reels is too valuable to risk for a feeder feature.

phases.name: Platform Expansion: Facebook
phases.goal: Extend to the platform that may be more native for life-documentation Journeys — Facebook skews older, is built around life events, and already has Groups, the communities Journeys want to live in.
ship: Journeys on Facebook, redesigned for the surface (not a reskin)
Integrated with Groups for discovery; framed around life events
Optional Instagram ↔ Facebook cross-posting
measure: Facebook Journey adoption & retention vs Instagram
Do life-documentation types over-index on Facebook (the core hypothesis)?
Facebook Group → Journey discovery rate

decision.label: Go
decision.text: Life-documentation Journeys over-index on Facebook → expand investment; it’s found a second native home.

decision.label: Contain to Instagram
decision.text: Facebook adoption weak → the format may be Instagram-native; don’t force a port the data doesn’t support.

phases.name: Long-Horizon: Meta Glasses Coaching
phases.goal: Close the flywheel. The same Meta AI that guided you inside a Journey now coaches you in the real world — opt-in, and treated as an enhancement rather than a make-or-break bet.
ship: Opt-in glasses integration: hands-free capture to a Journey
Real-world coaching tied to Journey state (golf swing, run pacing)
Closes the loop: capture → Journey holds → graph rewards → AI guides → glasses coach
measure: Glasses-Journey opt-in among glasses owners
Glasses-captured posts per Journey
Does it lift retention / completion? Coaching satisfaction

decision.label: Additive enhancement
decision.text: Exploratory — measured as an additive enhancement, NOT a survival gate. It’s the strategic moat (graph + creators + cross-app surfaces + hardware), but the core product must stand on its own long before this lands.
